label: OneSignal
description: Send messages and manage audiences, templates, and journeys

operations.name: cancel_message
operations.description: Stop a scheduled or currently outgoing message.

operations.name: copy_template_to_another_app
operations.description: Create a duplicate of a OneSignal message template in another app within the same organization. The new template will retain the same content but have a unique template ID.

operations.name: create_alias
operations.description: Create or update one or more user aliases when you already know an existing alias. This API upserts the user's identity object: it adds new aliases or updates existing ones.

operations.name: create_alias_by_subscription
operations.description: Create or update an alias for a user using a known subscription ID.

operations.name: create_an_app
operations.description: Programmatically create a new OneSignal app via the REST API. This guide explains required fields, supported platform configurations (Web, Android, iOS), and how to properly authenticate using your Organization API key.

operations.name: create_api_key
operations.description: Use the OneSignal API to create a new Rich Authentication Token (App API Key) for a specific app. This guide explains how to authenticate with the Organization API key and configure optional IP allowlists using CIDR notation.

operations.name: create_custom_events
operations.description: The Custom Events API allows you to record user events. Custom events can represent any action users take in your application, such as completing a purchase, viewing content, or achieving milestones.

operations.name: create_journey
operations.description: Create a new journey. Journeys are always created in the `draft` state; sending a server-controlled field such as `state` or `id` returns a `400` validation error. Send an empty `nodes` array to create a journey with only its required defaults.

operations.name: create_segments
operations.description: Programmatically create segments in your OneSignal app using flexible filters and targeting rules.

operations.name: create_subscription
operations.description: Attach a new subscription (email, SMS, or push) to an existing OneSignal user identified by an alias.

operations.name: create_template
operations.description: Create reusable message templates for push, email, and SMS channels. Templates can be accessed through both the dashboard and API using a `template_id`.

operations.name: create_user
operations.description: Create a new user or modify the subscriptions associated with an existing User.

operations.name: delete_alias
operations.description: Remove a specific alias from a user.

operations.name: delete_api_key
operations.description: Delete a specific Rich Authentication Token (App API Key) for a OneSignal app. Requires your Organization API Key and the token's unique ID, not the token value itself.

operations.name: delete_journey
operations.description: Permanently delete a journey by its UUID. Returns `{ "success": true }` on success. The authenticated App API key must have permission to delete journeys. Deleting a journey stops any in-flight users and cannot be undone.

operations.name: delete_segments
operations.description: Delete segments from OneSignal. Does not delete users or subscriptions.

operations.name: delete_subscription
operations.description: Delete a specific subscription by its subscription_id. This stops messages from being sent to that subscription but does not prevent future subscriptions with the same token.

operations.name: delete_template
operations.description: Permanently delete a specific message template from your OneSignal app using its template ID. Templates used in Journeys must be removed from those Journeys before deletion.

operations.name: delete_user
operations.description: Delete a user including all associated properties, subscriptions, and identity.

operations.name: delivery_metrics
operations.description: Get email bounce and spam complaint rates received for the app over the last 24 hours, 7 days, and 30 days.

operations.name: duplicate_journey
operations.description: Copy an existing journey. The copy is always in the `draft` state, whatever state the source is in, and the source does not change. To shape the copy in the same request, send `overrides`. It is a journey document that is applied over the copy as a JSON Merge Patch ([RFC 7396](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7396)). Use it to create the co

operations.name: estimate_notification_recipients
operations.description: Returns the estimated number of recipients for a notification's targeting, without creating or sending anything.

operations.name: export_audience_activity_csv
operations.description: Export a compressed CSV report of audience-level delivery and engagement data for a specific message. This includes sent, delivered, clicked, failed, and unsubscribed events across Push, Email, and SMS channels.

operations.name: export_subscriptions_csv
operations.description: Generate a GZip-compressed CSV export of your current subscription data using this API endpoint.

operations.name: fetch_aliases
operations.description: Retrieve all aliases associated with a user using a known alias, such as an `external_id`, `onesignal_id`, or a custom alias. This API helps you map back to a user's full identity from any one piece of identifying information.

operations.name: fetch_identity_by_subscription
operations.description: Retrieve all aliases linked to a user using a known `subscription_id`. This is useful when the user's identity is unknown but you have access to one of their push, email, or SMS subscriptions.

operations.name: list_audit_logs
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated, time-scoped list of audit log events for an organization. Requires an Enterprise plan with the audit logs entitlement enabled.

operations.name: message_history
operations.description: View which subscriptions received a particular message

operations.name: rotate_api_key
operations.description: Rotate an existing App API Key (Rich Authentication Token) for a OneSignal app. Useful when a token is compromised or needs replacement without creating a new key from scratch.

operations.name: send_email
operations.description: Send a message using the email channel.

operations.name: send_push_notification
operations.description: Send a message using the push notification channel.

operations.name: send_sms
operations.description: Send a message using the SMS channel.

operations.name: start_live_activity
operations.description: Remotely start a Live Activity on iOS devices via OneSignal's REST API. Define the activity type, target users, and send dynamic, updatable content directly to a Live Activity interface.

operations.name: test_connection
operations.description: Verify the configured app or organization API key.

operations.name: transfer_subscription
operations.description: Transfer a Subscription to a different user within the same OneSignal app. Useful for associating existing Subscriptions like push, email, or SMS with a new or updated user identity.

operations.name: unsubscribe_with_token
operations.description: Unsubscribe an email address from future messages by calling this API from your custom unsubscribe page. Automatically disables the associated email subscription using a token-based approach.

operations.name: update_an_app
operations.description: Use to update the name or push platform configuration of an existing app. This guide explains required parameters and platform-specific update rules

operations.name: update_api_key
operations.description: Update a Rich Authentication Token (App API Key) for a OneSignal app. Modify the token's name or IP allowlist settings using your Organization API Key.

operations.name: update_journey
operations.description: Apply a partial update to a journey using JSON Merge Patch ([RFC 7396](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7396)). Send only the fields you want to change; omitted fields are left unchanged. A `null` value clears a nullable field, and arrays such as `nodes` are replaced wholesale rather than merged element-wise. operations.name: update_journey_node
operations.description: Apply a partial update to a single node, located by its server-assigned `id`, using JSON Merge Patch ([RFC 7396](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/rfc7396)). operations.name: update_live_activity_api
operations.description: Update or terminate running iOS Live Activities using OneSignal's Live Activities API. This endpoint enables real-time content updates and activity termination, ensuring dynamic, context-aware user experiences.

operations.name: update_segment
operations.description: Update an existing segment's name and/or filters. The name parameter is always required. When filters are provided, all existing filters are replaced with the new ones.

operations.name: update_subscription
operations.description: Update properties on an existing OneSignal subscription using its subscription_id. Commonly used to enable or disable a subscription when managing outside of the OneSignal SDK.

operations.name: update_subscription_by_token
operations.description: Update properties on an existing Subscription using its token. Commonly used to enable or disable subscription status when managing outside of the OneSignal SDK.

operations.name: update_template
operations.description: Update existing OneSignal message templates for push, email, or SMS. Changes apply immediately across dashboard and API usage via the `template_id` reference.

operations.name: update_user
operations.description: Modify a user's properties.

operations.name: view_an_app
operations.description: View the details of a single OneSignal app

operations.name: view_api_keys
operations.description: View the details of all of your current app API keys (Rich Authentication Token) for a single OneSignal app.

operations.name: view_apps
operations.description: Retrieve a list of all OneSignal apps associated with your account, including key app details like name, App ID, subscription counts, and timestamps. Useful for managing multiple apps through the OneSignal API.

operations.name: view_journey
operations.description: Retrieve the full configuration of a single journey by its UUID, including its audience and node graph.

operations.name: view_journey_stats
operations.description: Retrieve performance stats for a single journey: journey-level entry and exit counts, per-node counts keyed by node `id`, per-branch counts keyed by branch `id`, and channel delivery stats for message-sending nodes. The response carries no definition detail, so join it by `id` against the journey from [View journey](/reference/view-journey).

operations.name: view_journeys
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of journeys for an app. Returns a summary representation of each journey; use [View journey](/reference/view-journey) for the full configuration. Uses forward-only cursor-based pagination.

operations.name: view_message
operations.description: View the details of a single message and the Outcomes associated with it.

operations.name: view_messages
operations.description: View the details for a collection of messages.

operations.name: view_outcomes
operations.description: View and export push notification outcome metrics such as clicks, conversions, and custom events.

operations.name: view_segment
operations.description: Retrieve details for a single segment by its ID, including subscriber count and optionally segment metadata and filters.

operations.name: view_segments
operations.description: Retrieve a list of segments associated with a specific OneSignal app. Useful for programmatically accessing segment metadata such as name, creation date, and status.

operations.name: view_template
operations.description: Retrieve the details of a specific message template in your OneSignal app using its template ID. This API returns the template content, target channel, and timestamps for creation and last update.

operations.name: view_templates
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of message templates from your OneSignal app. This endpoint returns summary information for each template, including ID, name, creation, and update timestamps.

operations.name: view_user
operations.description: Retrieve a user including aliases, properties, and subscriptions.
